Description
This rag and wicker haunted dollOA closely resembles Pilali in appearance—it even has diaphanous blue cloth wings. Nettle’s Poppet appears to be a hex dollUE, but its appearance adjusts to mimic its owner after it has been carried for more than 24 hours.
